description: Thermodynamic cycles decomposed. Carnot ideal, Rankine + supercritical + reheat + regeneration, Brayton + combined cycle + intercooling, Otto + Diesel + Atkinson, refrigeration cycles, absorption refrigeration, heat pumps.

sub_mechanisms.name: regenerative_Rankine
sub_mechanisms.definition: Steam extracted from turbine preheats feedwater. Reduces heat rejected at condenser.
sub_mechanisms.why: Improves Rankine efficiency. Modern power plants have multiple feedwater heaters. ~3-5% efficiency gain per heater.

sub_mechanisms.name: supercritical_Rankine
sub_mechanisms.definition: Operate above critical pressure (22 MPa for water). No phase boundary; continuous transition.
sub_mechanisms.why: Higher efficiency. Modern plants: 25 MPa, 600°C → 45%+ efficiency. Ultra-supercritical pushes further. Cost: exotic materials.

sub_mechanisms.name: reheat_cycle
sub_mechanisms.definition: Steam expanded partially, reheated, expanded again. Avoid wet steam in low-pressure turbine.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard in large power plants. Improves efficiency + prevents blade erosion. Single reheat common; double in some designs.

sub_mechanisms.name: combined_cycle
sub_mechanisms.definition: Brayton + Rankine: gas turbine exhaust drives steam cycle. Modern peakers + base load.
sub_mechanisms.why: 60%+ efficiency vs ~40% standalone. Standard modern gas plant. CCGT = Combined Cycle Gas Turbine.

sub_mechanisms.name: intercooling_recuperation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Intercool: cool gas between compression stages, reducing work. Recuperate: preheat compressed air with turbine exhaust.
sub_mechanisms.why: Improves Brayton efficiency. Intercooler + recuperator + reheater = best Brayton. LMS100 aero-derivative gas turbine.

sub_mechanisms.name: Atkinson_Miller_cycle
sub_mechanisms.definition: Variant of Otto with expansion stroke > compression stroke. Higher efficiency, lower power.
sub_mechanisms.why: Hybrid car engines (Prius). Trade: efficiency for power. Atkinson via late intake closing (effectively).

sub_mechanisms.name: vapor_compression_refrigeration
sub_mechanisms.definition: Standard cycle: evaporator → compressor → condenser → expansion valve. Refrigerant phase changes.
sub_mechanisms.why: Universal AC + refrigeration. COP = Q_cold/W. R134a, R410a, R32, R290 refrigerants. Standard.

sub_mechanisms.name: absorption_refrigeration
sub_mechanisms.definition: Uses heat (not compressor) to drive cycle. Lithium bromide-water or ammonia-water.
sub_mechanisms.why: Where waste heat available. Cogen + district cooling. Low COP but uses heat (often free). Industrial application.

sub_mechanisms.name: heat_pump_COP
sub_mechanisms.definition: Heating COP = Q_hot/W. Theoretical max = T_H/(T_H-T_C). >1 because moving heat, not creating.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern heating: 3-4 COP at moderate climates. Better than 1.0 max for electric resistance. Climate strategy.

sub_mechanisms.name: isentropic_efficiency
sub_mechanisms.definition: η = (actual work) / (isentropic work). Loss vs ideal.
sub_mechanisms.why: Real turbines, compressors, pumps not isentropic. Typical turbine: 85-90%. Compressor: 80-85%. Standard in cycle analysis.

sub_mechanisms.name: Mollier_diagram
sub_mechanisms.definition: h-s (enthalpy-entropy) chart for steam. Read process states.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard Rankine analysis tool. Modern: software tables. Foundation of steam plant design.

sub_mechanisms.name: exergy_analysis
sub_mechanisms.definition: Available work potential. Distinguishes useful from waste energy.
sub_mechanisms.why: Second-law analysis. Heat at high T has more exergy than same at low T. Identifies process improvements.

derivation_rules.name: higher_temperature_higher_efficiency
derivation_rules.why: η = 1 - T_C/T_H. Higher T_H = closer to 100%. Drives turbine inlet temperatures higher each generation. Materials limit.

derivation_rules.name: combined_cycle_60_percent_efficient
derivation_rules.why: Gas turbine 40% + bottoming 30% on exhaust = ~60%. Standard modern gas-fired plant. Best fossil efficiency.

derivation_rules.name: heat_pump_beats_electric_resistance
then: heat pump 3-4x more efficient than resistance
derivation_rules.why: Resistance: COP = 1. Heat pump: COP 3-4. Same electricity, 3-4× heat delivered. Climate strategy for decarbonisation.

derivation_rules.name: refrigerant_choice_balances_GWP_efficiency
derivation_rules.why: R134a high GWP (1430). R32: 675. R290 (propane): 3. R32 widespread; R290 emerging. Regulation drives change.

derivation_rules.name: isentropic_efficiency_real_world_correction
then: apply isentropic efficiency for realistic predictions
derivation_rules.why: Ideal cycle: optimistic. With efficiencies: realistic. Standard practice. Modern analyses include details (cooling, leakage, mechanical losses).
